title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Volumetric Brain Analysis Correlated with CSF Biomarkers in Alzheimer's Disease: A Pilot Study.
summary: In 21 Indonesian patients with Alzheimer disease, AI-assisted MRI volumetry correlated regional brain volumes with CSF Aβ42 (including right entorhinal and posterior cingulate indexed volumes). This is a small cross-sectional association, not a diagnostic or causal result. The result is reported in the Diagnostics. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: uAI uses a deep-learning fully convolutional/ResNet-U-Net-based pipeline for brain segmentation and ROI volume extraction
organization: Universitas Indonesia; RSUPN Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo; Rumah Sakit Universitas Indonesia
